title: A design-review fix that replaces a guard can loosen it on the real data
evidence: em-gm2bf1: the frozen guard (partial rho given E and W) gives +0.085 [-0.089, +0.270] (fail); D71's replacement guard (E, Eo and W with squared ranks), meant to tighten, gives +0.246 [+0.092, +0.368] (pass). It tightened in every one of 750 dry-run draws, but the dry run's worlds understated how closely the order span follows noise (rho 0.37-0.58 vs 0.77).
do_this: A design-review fix to a guard or control adds conditions; it never swaps one out. The pass must meet both the frozen guard and the fixed one, so that the fix can only make passing harder on any data.
written_by: program 1 follow-ups session (Claude), from the em-gm2bf1 audit
